title: DAW: Dynamics-Aware Weighting for Deep Learning Forecasts of Chaotic Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.22277v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep learning surrogates for forecasting chaotic dynamical systems suffer from catastrophic error accumulation over long-term autoregressive rollouts. This behavior is partly tied to the underlying systems: chaotic spatiotemporal systems, such as the Kuramoto-Sivashinsky (KS) equation, visit phase space unevenly - dominated by recurrent, low-dimensional quiescent states (e.g., near-laminar flows) and punctuated by rare, dynamically complex topological transitions (e.g., wave-merging events). Under a sample-wise uniform objective, standard neural surrogates allocate their finite capacity to the statistically numerous quiescent states, under-representing the transient regimes that trigger disproportionate, localized errors. Existing imbalanced-regression methods reweight samples by target-space density. translated_title: 混沌系统深度学习预测中的动力学感知加权方法
translated_abstract: 深度学习替代模型在长期自回归滚动预测混沌动力系统时，会遭受灾难性的误差累积。这种行为部分源于底层系统的特性：混沌时空系统（如Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程）在相空间中的访问不均匀——以重复出现的低维静止状态（如近层流）为主，并伴有罕见的、动力学复杂的拓扑转变（如波合并事件）。在样本均匀的目标函数下，标准神经替代模型将其有限容量分配给统计上数量众多的静止状态，而低估了触发不成比例局部误差的瞬态区域。现有的不平衡回归方法通过目标空间密度对样本进行重新加权，然而，统计上的目标空间稀有性不一定与内在的动力学稀有性（吸引子的复发几何）相一致。
tldr: 本文提出一种动力学感知加权方法，通过根据吸引子的复发几何而非统计密度对训练样本加权，以改善深度学习模型对混沌系统长期预测的误差累积问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a dynamics-aware weighting method that weights training samples based on the recurrence geometry of the attractor rather than statistical density, to mitigate error accumulation in deep learning forecasts of chaotic systems.
